_note: Magic parity fixture (01-09): four independent scenarios exercising castSpell (a damage spell in a forced encounter, and a heal outside combat), drinkPotion, and readScroll. Seeds were found by a throwaway discovery script (engine-only, cross-checked for prototype parity before being committed here — same method 01-05/01-07/01-08 used) that scanned seeds 1-5000 via newRun(seed) for a Magic User whose rolled grimoire/scrolls made each scenario reachable at level 1: seed 8 is an Illusionist with Freeze in its grimoire (a lvl-1 offense spell, thrown kind); seed 7 is a Wizard with Heal in its grimoire and a scroll on hand. `castSpell` requires an `idx` field (the spell's index into content/spells.js's SPELLS array, matching engine/actions.js's castSpell.idx validation); `drinkPotion`/`readScroll` take no extra fields. `startCombat` is not in engine/actions.js's validated ACTION_TYPES (an internal function other rule domains call) -- see test/parity/combat-parity.test.js's header for why the harness special-cases it. Phase 23 Plan 04 (FID-06): the `cast-damage` scenario now carries a `divergence` record — Freeze pays out via killFoe, a deliberate rules change. Phase 31 (2026-09-16, CMB-01, user ruling "phobia is a penalty, not a lost action"): seed 8's Illusionist fears Beasts, so the Fight! split's phobia trigger now sets combat.afraid instead of the prototype's freeze flag — the record was upgraded from a Phase 23 field-only shape to a kind:"action-path" record (fromAction 0); the declared after-values are unchanged (re-measured and confirmed byte-identical). Phase 90 plan 06 (SPELL-12, user 2026-09-30): Lesser Summon and Phantom Host were removed and the Wizard lost the Illusion school, so a Wizard's, Illusionist's and Apprentice's chargen draws fewer main-rng values than the frozen prototype's and any scenario on such a seed can no longer replay in lockstep. The three scenarios that sat on one were RE-PICKED, each onto a Magic User of an unaffected sub-class (found by an engine scan of seeds 1-6000, confirmed action by action against the prototype sandbox): cast-damage 8 -> 243 (a Sorcerer with Freeze and a Beasts phobia), heal 7 -> 110 (a Court Mage with Heal), scroll 7 -> 19 (a Sorcerer whose scroll is copied into its book). Each scenario's chargenDivergence and floorFeatureShift were re-measured live for the new seed.

divergence.rationale: Freeze pays out (user decision 2026-09-14) — the prototype's thrown branch marked a frozen foe dead without calling killFoe, so a Freeze kill awarded no experience, coin, treasure roll, kill count, or ration; the engine now routes the kill through killFoe after emitting frozenSolid. Seed 8's Illusionist freezes the Shriek on a d10 roll of 1 (a hit), so this is the one parity scenario that now pays out where the prototype did not. killFoe's four draws (d6 sp roll, d10 coin roll, d20 treasure check, Beasts cooking d6) happen after the last compared action in this scenario, so no earlier draw position moves — items/wp/level and combat-null-on-both-sides are unchanged. Phase 31 (user ruling 2026-09-16: phobia is a penalty, not a lost action): the seed-8 Illusionist fears Beasts, so at Fight! the prototype set its freeze flag while the engine sets combat.afraid = 2 — the compared combat objects differ from action 0, hence the action-path shape (fromAction 0, kind action-path). The prototype's castSpell had no fear check, so both sides cast Freeze on the same draws: d10 roll 1 vs need 6 (prototype) / need 3 (engine, afraid -3) — still a hit; the halved damage (3 -> 2) is irrelevant because Freeze kills through killFoe regardless of hp. No draw position moves relative to the Phase 23 measurement, so the declared end fields are unchanged: sp 5, gold 51, kills 1, rations 5. Re-measured live on 2026-09-16 and confirmed byte-identical to the Phase 23 record. USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): HERO_SP_SCALE fitted to 0.28 rescales the killFoe sp grant (5 -> 1); FOOD_CLOCK held at 1.5 rescales the chargen ration base the +1 kill ration rides on (6 -> 7); gold/kills unaffected (measured). Re-measured live by replaying this scenario against the fitted engine, never hand-typed. User rulings 2026-09-28 (plan 79.2-01): "freeze should never kill outright. It should deal its damage and freeze an enemy for 1d4 rounds" and "if it hits and resists, deal damage, but no freeze." The Illusionist's Freeze still hits on the same draw (d10 roll 10 vs 8+, afraid -3) for the halved 2 damage, which leaves the Shriek standing at 1 hp; the survivor draws the hold's d4 (2), fails its intel resist (13 vs 20), and is frozen for 2 rounds (controlHeld freeze, then foeStillHeld left 1 in the same dispatch). Nothing dies, so killFoe's sp/coin/treasure/cooking draws and payouts are gone: the engine's end fields are sp 0, gold 50, kills 0 (each now equal to the prototype's, so the record's fields narrow to rations alone: 4 -> 6, the chargen base with no kill ration), and the fight is still on (combat is not compared on an action-path record). The prototype side is untouched. Measured live by replaying seed 8 against the live engine, never hand-typed. Phase 90 plan 06 (SPELL-12, user 2026-09-30): this scenario was RE-PICKED from seed 8 (an Illusionist) to seed 243 (a Sorcerer, Human) because the Illusionist's chargen now draws fewer main-rng values than the prototype's (see this scenario's chargenDivergence). Seed 243 keeps every property the scenario pins: a Magic User with Freeze in its book and a Beasts phobia (Bats and rats), so the Fight! split's phobia trigger still sets combat.afraid where the prototype set its freeze flag (action-path from action 0), the afraid caster still casts, and Freeze still hits. Measured live by replaying seed 243 against the live engine: Freeze hits Viper ({"dmg":3}), the survivor draws the hold's d4 (2), fails its intel resist and is frozen, with 1 round left after the same dispatch's tick (controlHeld freeze, then foeStillHeld). Nothing dies, the end fields are the chargen ration base only (rations 4 -> 6) and dead stays false. The prototype side is untouched.

chargenDivergence.rationale: USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): HERO_HP_SCALE fitted to 1.25 scales maxWP/wp at chargen (round(canon * 1.25)); FOOD_CLOCK held at 1.5 scales the class's starting rations (round(canon * 1.5)). Measured live via newRun(seed) vs the frozen prototype sandbox, never hand-typed. Phase 79.2 (user ruling 2026-09-27: floors 1-12 harder; locked by RF-79.2-02-3): HERO_HP_SCALE 1.25 -> 1.4 moves maxWP 33 -> 36, wp 33 -> 36 (the engine side, re-measured live; the prototype side is unchanged). Phase 90 plan 06 (SPELL-12, user 2026-09-30): this scenario's seed was RE-PICKED from 8 (a Illusionist) to 243 (a Sorcerer, Human). Lesser Summon and Phantom Host were removed and the Wizard lost the Illusion school, so a Wizard's, an Illusionist's and an Apprentice's chargen now draws fewer main-rng values than the frozen prototype's; every later draw (the floor, the encounter, the cast) lands on a different value, so a scenario on such a seed can no longer replay in lockstep. The new seed is a Magic User of a sub-class whose chargen draw count is unchanged (a Warlock, Sorcerer, Summoner, Cleric or Court Mage), found by an engine scan of seeds 1-6000 and confirmed action by action against the prototype sandbox. The grimoire differs from the prototype for an earlier, declared reason (not this plan): RULES-03 (Phase 75, user 2026-09-25) grant-time legality skips a spell whose school the sub-class has not opened yet (a Sorcerer's healing school opens at level 4), so Heal is not dealt and Weaken is dealt in its place; zero draws either way.

floorFeatureShift.rationale: USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): ENCOUNTER_DOTS fitted to { base: 7, perDepth: 0.3 } (from identity { base: 9, perDepth: 1 }) changes difficultyCurve(depth).dots — genFloor's feature-scatter loop (engine/maze.js) walks the SAME rng.shuffle(far) result but assigns the first dots array slots to the 'dot' feat before moving on to tele/chest/trap/climb/gorge, so a smaller dots count shifts every later feature category's starting index by the same delta, remapping which cells land on which feat — the rng cursor itself is UNCHANGED (the shuffle runs once regardless of dots; nothing after it draws more or fewer times), so this is a pure, deterministic re-mapping, not new randomness. This scenario never navigates the maze (combat/casting starts immediately at chargen), so only the BOOT floor (depth 1) is measured. Phase 90 plan 06: re-measured for the re-picked seed. Measured live via newRun(seed) vs the frozen prototype sandbox, never hand-typed.
